title: Midnight Ritual Retinol Renewal Serum
descriptionHtml:
✓ Good for: Anti-Aging✓ Clean at Sephora✓ Good for: Uneven Texture✓ Vegan✓ Retinol✓ Niacinamide
What it is: An effective yet gentle serum that works all night to help smooth the look of fine lines and visibly refine skin texture.

Skin Type: Normal, Dry, Combination, and Oily

Skincare Concerns: Fine Lines and Wrinkles, Pores, and Uneven Texture

Formulation: Cream

Highlighted Ingredients:
- Vegan Retinyl Linoleate: Improves the look of fine lines and wrinkles, discoloration, and enlarged pores.
- Niacinamide and Hyaluronic Acid: Help attract and hold moisture on the skin's surface.
- Tiger Grass Extract and Oatmeal Blend: Nourish the skin and minimize the look of redness.

Ingredient Callouts: This product is vegan and cruelty-free.

What Else You Need to Know: This serum
How to Use+
Suggested Usage:
-In the evening, apply one to two pumps over clean, dry skin.
-Can be used daily as part of your nighttime skincare routine.
Ingredients+

-Vegan Retinyl Linoleate: Improves the look of fine lines and wrinkles, discoloration, and enlarged pores.

-Niacinamide and Hyaluronic Acid: Help attract and hold moisture on the skin's surface.

-Tiger Grass Extract and Oatmeal Blend: Nourish the skin and minimize the look of redness.


Water/Aqua/Eau, Glycerin, Squalane, Caprylic/Capric Triglyceride, Cetearyl Alcohol, Glyceryl Stearate SE, Simmondsia Chinensis (Jojoba) Seed Oil, Propanediol, Sorbitan Stearate, Sclerotium Gum, Retinyl Linoleate, Retinol, Avena Sativa (Oat) Bran Extract, Centella Asiatica Extract, Niacinamide, Bisabolol, Rosa Canina Fruit Oil, Persea Gratissima (Avocado) Oil, Prunus Amygdalus Dulcis (Sweet Almond) Oil, Butyrospermum Parkii (Shea) Butter, Sodium Hyaluronate, Ricinus Communis (Castor) Seed Oil, Hydrogenated Castor Oil, Glycine Soja (Soybean) Oil, Tocopherol, Tocopheryl Acetate, Phytic Acid, Synthetic Beeswax, Copernicia Cerifera (Carnauba) Wax/Copernicia Cerifera Cera/Cire de carnauba, Maltodextrin, Caprylhydroxamic Acid, 1,2-Hexanediol, Sodium Benzoate, Potassium Sorbate, Levulinic Acid, Sodium Levulinate, Citric Acid, Sodium Hydroxide.




The list of ingredients is subject to change, please consult the packaging of the product purchased.
